contents.text: 恭喜你成功完成市集挖寶(4)！
台灣標本協會致力於結合標本製作與生態教育，推廣保存動物生命樣貌的觀念。提升大眾對生物多樣性、標本製作技術與環境教育的重視，並與國際交流以提升台灣標本製作技術。

The Taiwan Specimen Association is dedicated to integrating specimen preparation with ecological education, promoting the concept of preserving the forms of animal life. It aims to raise public awareness of biodiversity, specimen preparation techniques, and environmental education, while also engaging in international exchange to advance Taiwan’s specimen preparation practices.
